opening.argument: The video presents oral cancer and mouth tumors as an educational medical subject, not as a transaction or solicitation. Its stated focus is clear: “ORAL CANCER and tumors in the mouth, lips and tongue,” while the accompanying description identifies it as a 3D video discussing “oral cancer and tumors in the mouth.” It explains possible carcinogenic agents, including tobacco, alcohol, radiation, and human papillomavirus, and identifies the spread of cancer to another organ as metastasis. The branded Clínica Pardiñas presentation and the displayed clinic logo provide organizational context for that health information. Nothing in the described material offers a financial opportunity, requires payment, requests credentials, or presents another mechanism for extracting money or access from viewers.

citations.quote: ORAL CANCER and tumors in the mouth, lips and tongue
In this 3D video from Clínica Pardiñas (http://j.mp/cPardinas) we talk about oral cancer and tumors in the mouth.
There are various triggers or carcinogenic agents such as tobacco, alcohol, radiation, human papillomavirus, etc.
